instruction: Use Abaqus via the Command Line Interface (CLI) to perform a tensile analysis of a rectangular solid block: 1. Part: - 3D Deformable Solid, Extrusion - Sketch a rectangle from (0,0) to (12,8) in the Y-Z plane - Extrude along the global X-axis to length 120 mm - This creates a block with cross-section 12 mm x 8 mm and length 120 mm 2. Property: - Material Aluminum: E = 70000 MPa, nu = 0.33 - Solid Homogeneous section 3. Assembly: Create an instance. 4. Step: - Static, General, named Step-Load 5. Load: - Fix the end face at X=0 with Encastre boundary condition - Apply a uniform pressure of 8.33 MPa on the end face at X=120 mm in the +X direction (equivalent to a total 800 N tensile force) 6. Mesh: - Global seed size: 4 mm - Element type: C3D8R 7. Job: Create Job-BlockTension and submit for solving. 8. Visualization: - Review S11 stress contour at the mid-section (X ~ 60 mm) - Query U1 displacement at the center of the free end face (X=120 mm, Y=6 mm, Z=4 mm) 9. Save: - Model: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-BlockTension.cae - Results: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-BlockTension.odb [Software] To start Abaqus/CAE, run `C:\SIMULIA\EstProducts\2023\win_b64\resources\install\cmdDirFeature\launcher.bat cae` (adjust path to your install).
